explanation: OEIS A179537, Sun: Σ_{k=0}^{p−1} (42k + 37)(−1)^k a(k) ≡ p(21(p/7) + 16) (mod p²) 'for any prime p'. The formal statement excludes p = 7, a slight weakening, although numerically the congruence also holds at p = 7 (with (7/7) = 0). Otherwise it matches; checked for p < 300. Faithful (minor harmless restriction).
